dict.string: Speek needs access to your microphone to record audio for transcription.
Speek shows your words in the notch while you speak. Recognition for this preview happens on your Mac.
Speek uses the native applications you connect to read information and perform actions after review.
Speek uses screen recording only to read on-screen context for AI modes when you enable it.
Speek reads your calendars and creates or changes events after you review an action.
Speek reads reminders and makes changes after you review an action.
